The Right Strategy Makes a Difference.

A Real Water Oak Case Study.

From Listed to Sold.

My own Dad’s home is my real-life case study. With ongoing research and strategic marketing, his home went under contract in 63 days, and it’s now Sold.

Successfully under contract in a market where many homes take considerably longer.

$0 Spent on Advertising.

So What Did We Actually Do?

  • Positioned the Home Strategically: Analyzed Water Oak listings, comparable properties, competition, and market activity to establish a pricing and positioning strategy designed to attract qualified buyers.
  • Prepared the Property to Compete: Coordinated professional photography, supported thoughtful staging by the homeowners, and crafted listing remarks that highlighted the home’s strongest features from the start.
  • Measured Buyer Engagement: Monitored views, saves, inquiries, showings, and competing listings to identify what was working and where adjustments could improve response.
  • Refined the Marketing: Updated the presentation, refreshed the listing, and expanded exposure through no-cost online channels and local groups without spending on advertising.
  • Kept the Momentum Going: Continued working behind the scenes, making adjustments and keeping the process moving toward an accepted offer.

The Result: Sold. $0 Spent on Advertising.

My FSBO approach didn’t just match the market. It beat it by more than half. In a market where homes in this area commonly take several months to sell, this home was under contract far sooner than that.

Every sale is different, but my system is built to reduce market time. I don’t promise speed, but I promise a method that aims to improve outcomes.

Presentation changes everything

Buyers start forming an opinion about a home within seconds, often from the photos online, before they ever step through the door.

Buyers react emotionally before they think logically.

Light, cleanliness, and good photos shape how buyers feel about a home within seconds.

Small updates can make a big difference.

Buyers often think a home needs a major renovation, but simple changes like fresh paint, new flooring, and a little cleanup can completely change how it feels.

Visual clutter creates mental clutter.

Clean, open spaces photograph better, feel larger, and help buyers focus on the home itself, not the clutter.

Why I built this

This actually started from a conversation with a neighbor. He mentioned he might try selling his manufactured home on his own, and it got me thinking.

With my background in real estate, construction, landscaping, and photography, I started realizing I could help homeowners get their home ready to sell and feel more prepared throughout the process.

What I realized was that a lot of homeowners simply needed some help getting started. That idea turned into SingleWideShane.

Every home teaches me something new, and I pass it on to the next Water Oak homeowner selling their own home.

Quick questions

What do you do?

I’m Shane. I live in Water Oak, and I help Water Oak homeowners sell their own homes. I’m behind the scenes doing the research, marketing, and paperwork that keep the sale moving. I only work in Water Oak, with just a few homeowners at a time.

What does it cost?

A $900 flat fee, paid when we start working together. No commission, no contracts, and it’s the same whether or not your home sells.

How are you different from a traditional agent?

I’m a consultant, not an agent. You stay the seller and make the calls. I bring the pricing research, photography, listing copy, marketing, and updates on what buyers are doing, for one flat fee instead of a commission.

Are you licensed?

No. I’m not a licensed real estate agent, and I don’t act as one. What I offer is consulting. You can read the full details in the disclosure below.

Independent consulting disclosure

SingleWideShane provides flat-fee consulting services to homeowners who choose to sell their own manufactured homes. SingleWideShane does not buy or sell manufactured homes, take ownership or title to homes, or act as a real estate broker, real estate agent, or manufactured home dealer. The homeowner remains the seller of record, makes all sale decisions, and signs all transaction documents. Fees paid to SingleWideShane are for consulting services only and are not commissions or percentages of the sale price.

SingleWideShane is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or acting on behalf of Sun Communities, Water Oak Country Club Estates, or its sales office. Information on this site is general guidance only. Please confirm rules, fees, and lease terms directly with the community.
